independence_statement: Independent decisions made from the frozen raw corpus, protocol, public primary full texts, and official paper/artifact pages only.

included_records.title: Adaptive Branch Specialization in Spectral-Spatial Graph Neural Networks for Certified Robustness
included_records.screening_note: The formal bound covers the adaptively gated fused output under joint bounded structural and feature perturbations.

included_records.title: BALANCING ACCURACY AND ROBUSTNESS IN INTRUSION DETECTION: AN ENSEMBLE DEEP LEARNING APPROACH
included_records.screening_note: The paper defines and numerically reports randomized-smoothing certification for the final routed classifier, though certification details are sparse.

included_records.title: Improving the Accuracy-Robustness Trade-Off of Classifiers via Adaptive Smoothing
included_records.screening_note: A formal bounded-input guarantee is stated for an input-dependent composed classifier, although the learned adaptive gate is not itself numerically certified.

included_records.title: LAWS: Learning from Actual Workloads Symbolically -- A Self-Certifying Parametrized Cache Architecture for Neural Inference, Robotics, and Edge Deployment
included_records.screening_note: The self-certification theorem bounds the routed architecture's output error over its input domain and is therefore retained as a bounded-input output-safety guarantee.

included_records.title: MetaMoE: Formal Verification of Compositional Robustness and Scalability of Mixture-of-Experts Architecture
included_records.screening_note: The theorem and verifier cover the hard top-1 routed output under explicit assumptions, and numerical component certificates are reported.

included_records.title: MoËT: Mixture of Expert Trees and its Application to Verifiable Reinforcement Learning
included_records.screening_note: The executable SMT procedure verifies a bounded-state safety property of the complete hard-routed policy and closed-loop encoding.

included_records.title: On the Adversarial Robustness of Mixture of Experts
included_records.screening_note: The paper supplies formal routed-output Lipschitz robustness bounds but does not numerically instantiate them on the evaluated V-MoE artifacts.

included_records.title: Optimizing Robustness and Accuracy in Mixture of Experts: A Dual-Model Approach
included_records.screening_note: Formal bounds cover the routed model output, while the experiments do not numerically instantiate the certified radius.

limitations: The supplied upstream retrieval is explicitly partial for several protocol sources; no prevalence inference is permitted.
Title/abstract screening necessarily relies on heterogeneous index abstracts, including null abstracts and repository descriptions.

Some included guarantees address a bounded state/input domain or routed-output approximation error rather than a conventional image-classification certified radius; these are retained under the protocol's robustness-or-safety wording for later adjudication.
Full-text screening determines eligibility only; preliminary numerical-instantiation labels are not a substitute for the complete six-dimension artifact audit.
No authors were contacted, no dependencies were installed, and no certificate execution or model training was performed.
